name: 75024 · Plano, TX
findings: ZIP 75024 (Plano) has 225 nonprofit organizations. 85 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 71 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 75024 (Plano) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
